title: Report every failed controller from the task-exchange cleanup drain and suppress duplicates per controller
outcome: Report every failed controller from the task-exchange cleanup drain and suppress duplicates per controller
acceptance: drain_process_cleanup reports every controller whose cleanup failed (each with its group and surviving PIDs), not only the first in registry order
The CLI suppresses only drained failures whose controller the foreground error already reported, per controller, so a second failed controller's survivors are always printed
A test with two failed controllers, one already reported in the foreground, shows the other controller's diagnostic is printed
